entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Gwenna, the Eyes of Gaea, elven druid and scout of Dominaria who helped Harbin and later sacrificed herself for the Survivors of the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Person Gwenna helped when he arrived on Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Gwenna's land, which died in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Explosion that destroyed Argoth and caused tsunamis.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Owner of the shipyards in Korlis that Gwenna attacked.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Earth mother whose cry Gwenna heard as Argoth died.

entities.name: Temken
entities.description: Leader of the Survivors of the Sylex Blast whom Gwenna helped.

events.summary: Gwenna helps Harbin when he arrives on Argoth.
events.quote: Gwenna was an elf who helped Harbin when he arrived on Argoth.

events.summary: During the Sylex Blast Gwenna, attacking Urza's shipyards in Korlis, feels Argoth die and leads her warriors to flee inland from the tsunami.
events.quote: She shouted for her warriors to flee to the hills inland

events.summary: About a century later Gwenna sacrifices herself to help Temken and the survivors rebuild their society.
events.quote: Gwenna sacrificed herself to help Temken and the other Survivors of the Sylex Blast to rebuild their society.

relations.quote: Gwenna was an elf who helped Harbin when he arrived on Argoth.

relations.note: She sacrificed herself to help him.
relations.quote: Gwenna sacrificed herself to help Temken
